# Contract: CI/CD Pipeline

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- Docker Engine with Compose v2 and buildx is available on the host, and the user running items can start containers.
- Node.js 24 and npm are available, and `npm ci` has been run at the repository root so every workspace dependency (including `msw`, `testcontainers`, `@testcontainers/postgresql`, `tsx`) is installed.
- For CLI items that do not enable Testcontainers, a PostgreSQL 17 instance is reachable at the `DATABASE_URL` in `apps/backend/.env.test` (F01 convention).
- For `CLI-NETWORK-05`, the e2e stack from `docker/docker-compose.e2e.yml` is running and healthy under compose project `ci-e2e`.
- For `## CLI` › Image publish items, a local OCI registry (`registry:2`) is running and reachable at `localhost:5000` with an empty catalog at the start of the capability.
- The working tree is clean (no uncommitted changes and no `_probe/` folders) at the start of every item. Every probe file an item copies in is removed when the item ends.

**Static inputs:**
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/architecture/domain-imports-drizzle.ts` — a TypeScript module whose only content is an import from `drizzle-orm` plus one exported constant that uses it (delivered by F01). Used by: CLI-ARCH-02.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/architecture/application-imports-infrastructure.ts` — a TypeScript module that imports a named export from `src/infrastructure/clock/system-clock` (through the `@infrastructure/*` alias) and exports one constant using it. Used by: CLI-ARCH-03.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/lint/misformatted.ts` — a type-correct, lint-clean TypeScript module that violates the Prettier config (wrong indentation and double-spaced tokens). Used by: CLI-LINT-02.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/anonymization/non-anonymized-channel.json` — a JSON file containing `"channelId": "UCx9Rk2mQvT7bLpZ3nW8eYcA"` (24 chars, `UC` prefix, not `UCanon`). Used by: CLI-LINT-03.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/typecheck/type-error.ts` — a module that assigns a string literal to a variable declared as `number` (TS2322). Used by: CLI-TYPECHECK-02.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/under-threshold.ts` — a pure module with branching logic. Its paired specs (below) exercise it to between 60% and 79% line coverage and between 50% and 79% branch coverage. Used by: CLI-UNIT-02, CLI-UNIT-03.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/under-threshold.domain.spec.ts` — a passing Vitest spec that imports `@domain/_probe/under-threshold` and exercises only part of it. Used by: CLI-UNIT-02.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/under-threshold.application.spec.ts` — the same spec importing `@application/_probe/under-threshold`. Used by: CLI-UNIT-03.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/fully-covered.ts` and `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/fully-covered.domain.spec.ts` — a pure module and a passing spec (importing `@domain/_probe/fully-covered`) that reaches 100% line and branch coverage. Used by: CLI-UNIT-04.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/network/googleapis-probe.spec.ts` — a Vitest spec with one test that awaits `fetch("https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=id&mine=true")` and expects a 2xx response, with no handler registered. Used by: CLI-NETWORK-01, CLI-NETWORK-03.
- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/network/telegram-probe.spec.ts` — the same shape, fetching `https://api.telegram.org/bot000000000:TEST/getMe`. Used by: CLI-NETWORK-02.

- `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/needs/missing-architecture.json` — the all-success object without the `architecture` key. Used by: CLI-REQUIRED-04.

**Configuration:**
- `apps/backend/.env.test` (F01 convention) supplies the test `DATABASE_URL` and test `ENCRYPTION_KEY` for items that run test projects without Testcontainers.
- `TESTCONTAINERS_ENABLED=true` makes the integration project start its own `postgres:17` container and ignore the `.env.test` admin URL. The default is `false`. This mechanism is part of F16's deliverables.
- `scripts/ci/blocked-hosts.txt` lists at least `googleapis.com`, `www.googleapis.com`, `oauth2.googleapis.com`, `youtube.googleapis.com`, `youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com`, `accounts.google.com`, `api.telegram.org`.
- The publish test commit SHA is `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`. The publish test owner is `Contract-Owner`.
- The coverage threshold is 80% for lines and for branches, applied separately to `src/domain/**` and to `src/application/**`.
- "Probe placement" in an item means: copy the named static input to the named destination before `when`, and delete the destination (and any `_probe/` folder created) after the item.

**External dependencies:**
- Network access to the npm registry and to Docker Hub (`postgres:17`, `registry:2`, `rhysd/actionlint:1.7.7`, base images of `docker/Dockerfile`) while dependencies install and images build. No item contacts Google or Telegram endpoints.
- For items marked `hosted`: the GitHub repository `pedromeneghel/creator-insights-backend` with this feature's workflow merged to `main`; at least one completed push run of `ci.yml` on `main` whose `ci-required` job succeeded; branch protection applied once by a repository admin with `scripts/ci/configure-branch-protection.sh`; and a `gh` CLI authenticated with read access to the repository and its packages. Hosted items only read state.

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Clean-arch gates** — `node scripts/run-gates.mjs` — TypeScript, ESLint (zero warnings), dependency-cruiser, architecture check, madge (no cycles), and knip (no orphans) all exit 0 for `apps/backend`.
- **Unit tests** — `npm test` — the Vitest unit project passes, and line coverage on `src/domain` and `src/application` is at least 80%.
- **Containerized suite** — `docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test` — lint, typecheck, unit, integration, and e2e test levels all pass inside the container and the command exits 0.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| A PR runs lint, typecheck, architecture, unit, integration and e2e jobs; any failure blocks merge. | PIPE-TRIGGERS-01, PIPE-JOBS-01, PIPE-REQUIRED-01, PIPE-REQUIRED-02, CLI-REQUIRED-01, CLI-REQUIRED-02, CLI-REQUIRED-03, CLI-REQUIRED-04, CLI-LINT-02, CLI-TYPECHECK-02, CLI-E2E-02 |
| Coverage below 80% in `src/domain` or `src/application` fails the unit job. | CLI-UNIT-02, CLI-UNIT-03, CLI-UNIT-04, PIPE-JOBS-01 |
| An import from `src/domain` to `drizzle-orm` fails the architecture job. | CLI-ARCH-02, PIPE-JOBS-01 |
| No job performs a network request to googleapis.com or api.telegram.org. | CLI-NETWORK-01, CLI-NETWORK-02, CLI-NETWORK-03, CLI-NETWORK-05, CLI-NETWORK-06, PIPE-NETWORK-01 |
| A green push to `main` publishes `ghcr.io/<owner>/creator-insights-backend:<sha>` and `:latest`. | CLI-PUBLISH-01, PIPE-PUBLISH-01, PIPE-PUBLISH-02 |

### Unit coverage

**Common given:** commands run from `apps/backend` with the project's own `vitest.config.ts`; no other probe is present.

#### `CLI-UNIT-01` — clean tree passes with a coverage report
- given: (default), and a clean working tree
- when: run `npm run ci:unit` from the repository root
- then:
  - exit code 0
  - output contains a coverage table covering files under `src/domain` and `src/application`
  - `apps/backend/coverage/coverage-summary.json` exists after the run

#### `CLI-UNIT-02` — domain coverage below 80% fails
- given: (default), probe placement of `apps/backend/test/fixtures/ci/coverage/under-threshold.ts` at `src/domain/_probe/under-threshold.ts`, and of `under-threshold.domain.spec.ts` at `test/unit/domain/_probe/under-threshold.spec.ts`
- when: run `npx vitest run --project unit --coverage --coverage.include='src/domain/_probe/**' test/unit/domain/_probe`
- then:
  - the probe's own test passes
  - exit code is non-zero
  - output reports that coverage for lines or branches does not meet the `src/domain/**` threshold of 80%
  - output shows the measured percentage, which is below 80

#### `CLI-UNIT-03` — application coverage below 80% fails
- given: (default), probe placement of `under-threshold.ts` at `src/application/_probe/under-threshold.ts`, and of `under-threshold.application.spec.ts` at `test/unit/application/_probe/under-threshold.spec.ts`
- when: run `npx vitest run --project unit --coverage --coverage.include='src/application/_probe/**' test/unit/application/_probe`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - output reports that coverage does not meet the `src/application/**` threshold of 80%

#### `CLI-UNIT-04` — coverage at or above 80% passes
- given: (default), probe placement of `fully-covered.ts` at `src/domain/_probe/fully-covered.ts`, and of `fully-covered.domain.spec.ts` at `test/unit/domain/_probe/fully-covered.spec.ts`
- when: run `npx vitest run --project unit --coverage --coverage.include='src/domain/_probe/**' test/unit/domain/_probe`
- then:
  - exit code 0
  - output reports no threshold violation

## Pipeline

**Verification mode:** Parse `.github/workflows/ci.yml` as YAML and assert its declared structure, or run the named static linter on it; items marked `hosted` read repository state from GitHub with read-only `gh` queries.

### Triggers and jobs

#### `PIPE-TRIGGERS-01` — runs on every PR and on pushes to main
- given: the workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- when: read its `on` block
- then:
  - `pull_request` is a trigger with no branch filter
  - `push` is a trigger filtered to branch `main`
  - no other trigger is declared, apart from an optional `workflow_dispatch`

#### `PIPE-JOBS-01` — six check jobs, each calling its local entry point
- given: the workflow file
- when: read its `jobs` block
- then:
  - jobs `lint`, `typecheck`, `architecture`, `unit`, `integration`, `e2e`, `ci-required`, and `publish` exist
  - each of the six check jobs has a step whose `run` is exactly `npm run ci:<job name>`
  - none of the six check jobs declares `continue-on-error: true`
  - each of the six check jobs declares `timeout-minutes` of at most 15

#### `PIPE-JOBS-02` — setup and caching per job
- given: the workflow file
- when: read the steps of the six check jobs
- then:
  - each uses `actions/setup-node` with Node 24 and `cache: npm`
  - each runs `npm ci` before its `ci:` step
  - the `e2e` job builds the backend image with a `type=gha` cache source and destination before `npm run ci:e2e`

#### `PIPE-JOBS-03` — least-privilege permissions
- given: the workflow file
- when: read the top-level and per-job `permissions`
- then:
  - top-level permissions grant only `contents: read`
  - `packages: write` is granted only to the `publish` job

### Merge blocking

#### `PIPE-REQUIRED-01` — aggregate job depends on every check
- given: the workflow file
- when: read the `ci-required` job
- then:
  - `needs` lists exactly `lint`, `typecheck`, `architecture`, `unit`, `integration`, `e2e`
  - `if` evaluates `always()`
  - a step runs `npm run ci:required` with env `NEEDS_JSON` set to `${{ toJSON(needs) }}`

#### `PIPE-REQUIRED-02` — main requires the aggregate check (hosted)
- given: the hosted repository state described in Prerequisites
- when: run `gh api repos/pedromeneghel/creator-insights-backend/branches/main/protection`
- then:
  - the required status checks include `ci-required`
  - required status checks are strict (branch must be up to date)
  - admin enforcement is enabled
  - pull requests are required before merging

### Publish

#### `PIPE-PUBLISH-01` — publish only after a green push to main
- given: the workflow file
- when: read the `publish` job
- then:
  - `needs` includes `ci-required`
  - `if` requires `github.event_name == 'push'` and `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`
  - a login step authenticates to `ghcr.io` with `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`
  - a step runs `scripts/ci/publish-image.sh` with `REGISTRY=ghcr.io`, `IMAGE_OWNER` from `github.repository_owner`, and `GIT_SHA` from `github.sha`
  - the publish step receives `type=gha` cache settings

#### `PIPE-PUBLISH-02` — GHCR holds the SHA and latest tags of the last green main run (hosted)
- given: the hosted repository state described in Prerequisites; `<sha>` is the head SHA of the most recent successful push run of `ci.yml` on `main` (`gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main --event push --status success --limit 1 --json headSha`)
- when: run `gh api /users/pedromeneghel/packages/container/creator-insights-backend/versions`
- then:
  - one package version carries both tags `<sha>` and `latest`

### Duration

#### `PIPE-DURATION-01` — runs finish under 15 minutes (hosted)
- given: the hosted repository state described in Prerequisites
- when: run `gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main --status success --limit 5 --json createdAt,updatedAt`
- then:
  - for every listed run, `updatedAt` minus `createdAt` is under 15 minutes
- notes: measures the PRD duration target; npm and layer caches are warm after the first run

### Workflow validity

#### `PIPE-VALID-01` — workflow passes actionlint
- given: the workflow file
- when: run `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -w /repo rhysd/actionlint:1.7.7 -color=never` from the repository root
- then:
  - exit code 0
  - output reports no findings

### Network isolation

#### `PIPE-NETWORK-01` — test jobs block egress before running tests
- given: the workflow file
- when: read the steps of the `unit`, `integration`, and `e2e` jobs
- then:
  - each runs `scripts/ci/block-egress.sh` before its `npm run ci:<job>` step
  - the workflow references no secret other than `GITHUB_TOKEN`
  - no job sets an environment variable whose value contains `googleapis.com` or `api.telegram.org`
